crates: aegis-wasm (F14 guest ABI: linker allowlist, handles, quotas, frames)
spec_refs: SPEC §H I1, I2 (host-enforced budgets: epoch, limiter, host-call and I/O-byte quotas; USENIX'25 WASI I/O amplification)
ARCHITECTURE R-ISO-2 linker allowlist; no WASI

acceptance.cmd: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2 ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p aegis-p2 && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/p2-mutants ci/heavy.sh cargo build --release --locked -q -p aegis-p2 --features aegis-p2/mutants && oracles/hostile-modules/run --level worker --subject target/p2/release/aegis-p2 && oracles/hostile-modules/run --self-test --level worker --subject target/p2/release/aegis-p2 --mutant-subject target/p2-mutants/release/aegis-p2 && ci/remote.sh ci/heavy.sh cargo test --locked -q -p aegis-wasm
acceptance.must: PASS; every worker-level I1/I2 case holds on both paths; static import check refuses non-F14 imports before instantiation; mutants extra-import, handle-not-cleared, no-hostcall-quota, no-fuel-no-epoch, no-limiter red

notes: The worker forwards data_run/log/response frames to the supervisor; it enforces nothing that the supervisor must enforce (authorization and audit are P5-bin-002), but it bounds counts and bytes per request (I2) and kills the request on any quota breach.
